en.sayed-ali-raza: Allāh may shower His mercy on him who ponders and takes lesson thereby,
and when he takes lesson he achieves enlightenment. Whatever is present in this world would shortly not exist, while whatever is to exist in the next world is already in existence.
Every countable thing would pass away. Every anticipation should be taken to be coming up and everything that is to come up should be taken as just near.
